DEFINE.core_strategy: Enable multi-user collaboration by implementing an asynchronous event-driven bridge between database mutations and client UI updates, alongside a card-centric persistence model that tracks user authorship and temporal data.

rejected_alternatives.direction: Polling the database at fixed intervals for updates.
rejected_alternatives.tradeoff: Violates the core latency requirement and creates unnecessary backend load compared to event-driven push.

rejected_alternatives.direction: Client-side card state management with heavy local persistence.
rejected_alternatives.tradeoff: Increases risk of state divergence between participants; complicates the synchronization logic.

dependencies.description: Supabase Realtime API and supabase-py library support for async event subscriptions.

assumptions.description: The existing NiceGUI event loop can maintain a long-lived connection to Supabase Realtime without impacting UI responsiveness.
assumptions.how_checked: Verification during integration testing of the Realtime service implementation.
assumptions.if_false: The architecture will need to shift to a separate WebSocket gateway for Realtime events.

risks.description: High frequency of rapid updates during intense collaboration could saturate the event bus.
risks.mitigation: Implement debouncing on client-side card movements and batching of updates where appropriate.

DEFINE.thesis: We will bridge the collaborative gap by building a real-time event pipeline as the foundational service for all card-based interactions.

goals.description: Implement a real-time event pipeline ensuring all clients reflect state changes within the 2000ms threshold.
goals.success_metric: End-to-end latency from database mutation to client rendering < 2000ms.

goals.description: Enable full CRUD operations for cards within the quadrant UI.
goals.why: Participants need to interact with the canvas to make decisions.
goals.success_metric: 100% of inserted/moved cards correctly reflected across all active sessions.

success_criteria.criterion: Latency from server mutation to client update.

non_goals.tradeoff: Adds complexity and network load without immediate benefit to decision alignment.
We use anonymous session-based display names to maintain ephemeral, low-friction access.

in_scope: Card persistence schema (quadrant, index, display name, timestamp)
NiceGUI event handling for collaborative updates
out_of_scope: Exporting session state to external formats.

walkthrough.name: Multi-user card movement
with_strategy: User A enters 'Alice' and creates a card in Q1.
User B sees the new card appear in Q1 instantly with 'Alice' label and current timestamp.
User A moves the card to Q2.
User B sees the card move to Q2 instantly.
